name: ROWBOAT
note: Every t is a MEASURED word onset out of words_rowboat_tight.json, re-derived after the silence trim rather than scaled. TWO cutting passes: pass 1 removed the three KitKat restarts (54.98 -> 38.70), pass 2 removed the dead air BETWEEN sentences (seven silences totalling 5.93s, trimmed to a 0.22s beat each, -4.35s -> 34.36). Fourteen scenes across thirteen places, alternating warm/cool so every cut is a colour change too - `lawn` is the one deliberate repeat, because the hook buries the agency and S5 comes back to the same grave.
hook: D THE FUNERAL (rowWake) - picked by Alex. HOOK_LEN 138, cuts at f28/f60/f98, camera locked.

scenes.vo: Forget Claude Code or Cursor, forget paying developers to build AI agents, because this is gonna hurt.
scenes.job: THE OPEN - the funeral. Four hard-cut shots, camera locked.
scenes.header: SOLD THEIR LAST STARTUP / GAVE THIS ONE AWAY

scenes.vo: Two guys who already sold their startup to Coinbase
scenes.job: the credential - the company walks off the plaza
scenes.warn: "Two guys" is THREE - Arjun Maheswaran, Ramnique Singh, Akhilesh Sudhakar. Coinbase bought AGARA in 2021, NOT Rowboat. No count on screen.

scenes.vo: just quietly open sourced a tool that does it all in plain English.
scenes.job: the next crate goes DOWN and gets a FREE sign

scenes.vo: Y Combinator backed it, and it's completely free.
scenes.job: real YC mark + a price that is a zero
scenes.header: Y COMBINATOR S24 / AND IT IS FREE

scenes.vo: And it's just made every AI agency in the world
scenes.header: EVERY AI AGENCY / JUST GOT REPLACED

scenes.job: back to the grave - the one deliberate repeat
the sheet comes off the signboard
scenes.warn: MONOCHROME brand - a black sail on a white tile. Do not tint it.

scenes.vo: You just describe what you want your AI agent to do in normal words.
The copilot builds the entire multi-agent system for you,
scenes.job: a gantry lowers three agents onto a deck, then the links get drawn
scenes.header: THE COPILOT BUILDS / THE WHOLE SYSTEM
scenes.warn: PIVOT-DEPENDENT. Verified 2026-08-04: rowboatlabs/rowboat now ships an open-source AI COWORKER WITH MEMORY - desktop app, local knowledge graph, email client, background agents, browser, meeting notes, Code Mode. The copilot-builds-a-multi-agent-system product is ~Apr 2025. Scenes 7, 8 and 12 are ~10s of a 38.7s reel making a claim the shipping product no longer makes. Alex's call on 2026-08-04 was BUILD IT AS RECORDED. These are the shots to pull first if that is revisited.

scenes.vo: multiple agents working together, connected to your tools,
scenes.job: four agents land, each with a real MCP mark the README names
scenes.header: AGENTS WIRED TO / SLACK, LINEAR, JIRA

scenes.vo: Think of it like having an entire AI development team
scenes.job: the team, staged on depth not as bookends

scenes.vo: that takes orders in English and delivers in seconds.
scenes.job: the order travels and becomes the thing; a rail fills end to end
scenes.header: ORDERS IN ENGLISH / DELIVERED IN SECONDS
scenes.warn: NO CLOCK ON SCREEN - "in seconds" has no sourceable duration behind it, so the travel carries the speed instead of a digit. PIVOT-DEPENDENT - see scene 8.

scenes.vo: It's open source, and the founders already proved they can build AI that works.
scenes.job: the close - repo, licence, stars, all checkable

scenes.vo: Comment ROWBOAT and I'll send you the direct link.
